upstream.license: Upstream README describes a public-domain collection; individual edition rights are not independently verified. Local evaluation only; do not redistribute source files.

selection: Three named solo-piano works from three composers in the metadata inventory, before opening score content. No replacements based on admission or predictions. No Mozart or Vienna4x22 development works.

inputs.primaryRecognitionInput: Complete rendered work, no cropping, omission, notation edits or alternate editions.
inputs.hashes: Materialization MUST record all input and rendered PDF SHA-256 values before truth evaluation.

execution.allSourceRejectedAction: Record not-evaluable; no inference or zero-regression claim.

gates.wholeWorkMetrics: Pitch TP/F1 and strict staff-measure match MUST NOT regress for any evaluated work.
gates.failurePolicy: Any unmet gate prevents default activation. Rejected works remain in the denominator.
gates.tuningPolicy: No candidate changes after inspecting inputs or truth may reuse this batch as independent.
